name: Drizzlefox · Gremlet #29
description:
A blue-grey fox kit that only comes out when it rains. Its freckles look like raindrops.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Drizzlefox in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
